QuestInfo.0: The monsters of the Crimsonwood Keep have changed. Hunt them to see how much they've changed.

QuestInfo.2: The monsters of the Crimsonwood Keep have changed. Hunt them to see how much they've changed.

0.0: The monsters of Crimsonwood Keep have grown far too powerful. You'll need to be very careful if you poke your nose in there.
0.1: What, you want to test their strength? Are you crazy? I mean, I won't stop you...

1.0: Ha, I knew it. You are amazing. I have no fear of monsters when you're around.
1.1: Hey, so... does that mean you can come fight the monsters around here tomorrow, too?

mob.0: Defeat the monsters of Crimsonwood Keep to learn more about them.
